title: Linear changelog strip
description: A 48px 'Changelog' title over a horizontal timeline: four entries, each starting at a small ringed dot on a thin rule (the newest dot glows coral), with a medium-weight title, two clipped grey lines and a monospace capital date, then a grey 'View all →' link. Hidden on phones by default, as on the original.
notes: four entries fill the row; the first is marked as the newest (chart-1 colour)
showOnPhones stacks the entries in a column below lg instead of hiding the block
